- memory_id "1000267": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000246" [preference]: As of 2025-03-19, for anything Ember-related, page Oskar.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000243" [decision]: As of 2025-03-19, the Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000240" [constraint]: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000196": On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000162" [preference]: For the Atlas on-call cycle starting 2025-02-19, page Tomasz Nowak instead of Priya for anything.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000135": The scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000094": Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000075": Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000001": In 2025, Team Atlas consists of Priya and Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
